# GOEXPERIMENT=arm64e changes the architecture that cgo and the C compiler
# target, so their cached results must not be shared with ordinary builds.

[!GOOS:darwin] skip
[!GOARCH:arm64] skip
[!cgo] skip

# clear CC, in case user sets it
env CC=

env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $GOCACHE

go build -o a.exe .

env GOEXPERIMENT=arm64e
go build -x -o b.exe .
stderr 'cgo -objdir'
stderr 'clang.*-arch arm64e'

env GOEXPERIMENT=
go build -o c.exe .

# On ios, CC chooses the architecture, so the C compiler gets no -arch
# flag, but the experiment can still change the output of cgo.
env GOOS=ios
env CGO_ENABLED=1
go build ./lib
env GOEXPERIMENT=arm64e
go build -x ./lib
stderr 'cgo -objdir'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.26
-- main.go --
package main

// int f(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func main() { println(C.f()) }
-- lib/lib.go --
package lib

// int g(void) { return 2; }
import "C"

func G() int { return int(C.g()) }
